title: Request a YouTube video
prompt: What should you include when asking the AI to play a YouTube video?
hint: Say you must include the video's title in the request.

ja.hint: 依頼に動画のタイトルを含めるべきだと伝えてください。

local.prompt: 當你請 AI 在 YouTube 播放影片時，應該包含什麼？
local.hint: 說明要在請求中包含影片標題。

title: Where was the moth taped?
prompt: Where did Grace Hopper tape the moth she found in the computer?
hint: Say that she taped the moth in her logbook.
sample: She taped it in her logbook.

ja.prompt: グレース・ホッパーは、コンピュータで見つけた蛾をどこに貼りましたか？
ja.hint: 蛾を自分のログブックに貼ったと言ってください。
ja.sample: She taped it in her logbook.

local.prompt: Grace Hopper 將她在電腦中發現的蛾貼在哪裡？
local.hint: 說她把蛾貼在她的日誌（logbook）裡。
local.sample: She taped it in her logbook.

local_pron.prompt: Grace Hopper jiāng tā zài diànnǎo zhōng fāxiàn de é tiē zài nǎlǐ?
local_pron.hint: Shuō tā bǎ é tiē zài tā de rìzhì (logbook) lǐ.
local_pron.sample: She taped it in her logbook.

zh.prompt: Grace Hopper 把她在電腦裡發現的蛾貼在哪裡？
zh.hint: 說她把蛾貼在她的日誌（logbook）裡。
zh.sample: She taped it in her logbook.

en.hint: Say that she taped the moth in her logbook.
en.sample: She taped it in her logbook.
